objective: Ordinary equal-point batch MSE; chunk sums divided by batch target element count, one Adam step per update.
nesting: Balanced 4096-point blocks from one CPU generator seeded training_seed+91000. Exact old 4096-point dataset is prefix. Prefix counts 50% original, 25% full gap, 25% facing interior.
schedule: Cosine restart identical to earlier fixed-data diagnostic: update 1 = 1e-4, update 10000 = 1e-6. Adam moments and step counts retained.
independent_distribution: Same block sampling/composition per sampler, common evaluation seed across training seeds and densities; disjoint coordinates checked.
primary_gate: All original gap and plate probes correct; two components, Euler 4, closed edges, resolved analytic reference at BOTH 192 and 384.
fit_gate: Each of original/gap/interior subsets RMSE <=0.001 and 100% training signs for abs(true SDF)>0.001. Descriptive diagnostic only; failure is not representational impossibility.
persistence: Unchanged structural gate at both 26000 and 30000. Report all checkpoint failures/regressions; no claim between observed checkpoints.
decision: Persistent restoration across all six pairs at a denser size supports coverage. Fitted finite data with failed geometry motivates between-sample bridge localisation. Unfitted dense data leaves optimisation/capacity unresolved. Mixed outcomes stay mixed.
compute: 10000 updates. Count batch points times updates; all 65536 pool labels retained. Report measured training and evaluation seconds separately. No storage or label savings claimed.

protocol.hypothesis: The intermediate 8192-point cycle reduces gradient noise enough to retain the dense baseline's persistent structure and error guardrails, while using one eighth of its point presentations.
protocol.prior_result: Batch 2 audited: 4096 cycling retained 5/6 persistent structural passes; local seed 33 failed at 26000 and passed at 30000. Gap RMSE ratios were 1.1997684711676977 at 26000 and 1.11778782496037 at 30000, both outside the frozen 1.10 guardrail. Training-time ratio was 0.2989593492854896 and presentation ratio 0.0625. It does not qualify despite 6/6 final structural passes. Batch 1's 16384 cycling remains the qualifying candidate.
protocol.controls: Same six 20000-update model/Adam states, exact dense pools, ordinary MSE, architecture, 10000-update cosine schedule, independent probes and unchanged 192/384 gate. Compare to audited batch-1 dense and 16384 cycling, retaining batch-2 failures. No optimizer reset, no extra training seeds, no changed loss, no altered evaluation criterion.
protocol.decision_criteria: All six trajectories must pass at both 26000 and 30000 and both resolutions; aggregate training time <=0.90 of batch-1 dense; fewer point presentations. At BOTH later checkpoints, mean Chamfer at each grid <=1.05 times dense, mean independent gap RMSE <=1.10 times dense, and mean full-gap sign accuracy no more than 0.5 percentage points below dense. Missing meshes fail. Report all seeds and checkpoints even if a criterion already fails. No relaxation after seeing results.
protocol.pairing: Eight disjoint balanced 8192-point blocks cycle through the exact 65536-point pool. Each update has 4096 original, 2048 gap and 2048 interior points. Starting model/Adam and original sampling RNG are shared by matched policy/seed; streams intentionally differ by batch size. Original independent evaluation sets remain disjoint and unused for selection.
protocol.budget: Third and final new experiment batch. Cumulative training/evaluation must remain below 7200 seconds. Entire process wall time charged with the existing hard watchdog; logs, checkpoints and partial results retained. No fourth batch, including no phase-shift experiment, under this goal.
protocol.scope: Existing development geometry and seeds only. No fresh cases evaluated. All dense labels and storage retained. Savings refer only to the additional continuation stage. Later timing comparisons reuse batch-1 dense timings and are not a controlled speed benchmark.
protocol.next_decision: Stop after this batch and its audit. If 8192 qualifies, report it as the lowest-presentation qualifying tested size, with untested order sensitivity and held-out generalisation as limitations. If it fails, retain 16384 as the best supported qualifying size. Preserve the 4096 negative result either way. Recommend a separately frozen confirmation study without consuming reserved cases now.

selection: At update j=1..10000 select contiguous n-point balanced blocks at index (j-1+phase) modulo (65536/n). All pool points once per cycle. Fixed deterministic order, ordinary equal-point batch MSE; this changes gradient noise and ordering, not just coverage.
